messages.msg: Lecture 18 gives the fields of ArticleForm value={article.title} and onChange, ready-made, and says in one sentence that value makes the field show what state holds and that Lesson 20 explains the pair. Map 18 dates the term 'controlled input (`value` and `onChange`)' New in Q18, so map 20 must mark it Recall from Q18 under that exact name. Lesson 18 also shows the field giving back a typed key when the state does not change (the title changed in place, or the dots written after the change); Lesson 20 can recall that scene when it explains why a controlled field shows only what state holds.
